teaser.en: A little-known shrub of the coffee family that lives in the shade of the coastal forest floor.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kisichojulikana sana cha familia ya mibuni, kinachoishi kivulini kwenye sakafu ya msitu wa pwani.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka chidide cha jamii ya kahawa chisichomanyikana sana, chinachokala pepho photsi ya mihi mikulu ya matsaka ga pwani.

summary.en: *Chigamba* is a small shrub of the coffee family that grows in the understorey of coastal forests. Pakia records the name, but not its meaning or any uses.
summary.sw: *Chigamba* ni kichaka kidogo cha familia ya mibuni kinachoota katika sehemu ya chini ya misitu ya pwani. Pakia ameandika jina hili, lakini si maana yake wala matumizi yoyote.
summary.dg: *Chigamba* ni chitsaka chidide cha jamii ya kahawa chinachomera photsi ya mihi mikulu ya matsaka ga pwani. Pakia anaandika dzinare, ela kaandika manage wala matumizige.

about.en: *Chazaliella abrupta* is a small shrub or treelet of the coffee family with opposite, glossy leaves and small flowers in clusters, followed by small fleshy fruits.
about.sw: *Chazaliella abrupta* ni kichaka kidogo au kimti cha familia ya mibuni, chenye majani yanayoelekeana na yanayong'aa, na maua madogo yaliyo katika vishada, yanayofuatwa na matunda madogo yenye nyama.
about.dg: *Chazaliella abrupta* ni chitsaka chidide au muhi mdide wa jamii ya kahawa. Makodzage ganamera jozi-jozi ganalengana, na ganang'ala; maruwage ni madide na ganamera kpwa mafungu, na bada yao kunatuluka matunda madide genye nyama.

where.en: It grows in the shaded understorey of East African coastal forests.
where.sw: Huota katika sehemu ya chini yenye kivuli ya misitu ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.
where.dg: Chinamera pepho photsi ya mihi mikulu kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chigamba* and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika jina la Kidigo *chigamba* na analiorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chigamba* na anariika kahi ya madzina gasigoweza kuelezwa manage. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: Psychotria, a close relative in the coffee family
reason.sw: Psychotria, jamaa wa karibu katika familia ya mibuni
reason.dg: *Psychotria*, ndugu wa phephi wa jamii ya kahawa

reason.sw: Polysphaeria, kichaka cha msituni cha familia ya mibuni
reason.dg: *Polysphaeria*, chitsaka cha tsaka cha jamii ya kahawa
